info.name: OptiTime API (complete)
info.description:
Laravel API under `/api`. Set `base_url` (e.g. http://localhost:8000) and `token` from Login.

Replace `{{..._uuid}}` variables with real UUIDs from your DB or seed.

`POST /schedule/generate` is open in local/testing; in production requires Bearer + `schedule.generate` permission.

request.description: Returns token. Copy value into collection variable `token`.

item.name: Generate schedule (local/testing: no auth; prod: Bearer + schedule.generate)

query.description: Optional: filter sections by courses offered in semester
